notes.title: Demo v3.5 is up and ready to go!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!!! 
There a new version of the Demo out (v3.5)!!!!!!

[h1]Here's a breakdown of the update:[/h1]

- One of the most talked about things of our demo has been the fact that phones lines do not require power to work (thank you all for that knowledge, btw). So we went and changed some of the functionality and dialogue for those scenes involving the phone. ^~^ This helped bring a bit more realism to our world and we thank you all for bringing it to life!

- We changed up the Laundry Chute puzzle a bit to differentiate from the use of moons, so we decided to make it a Star Key instead of a Moon Key. Now there shouldn't be any confusion when using anything Moon shaped.

- The sketch showing the gazebo puzzle's bell boxes has been moved upstairs.



Some things we are still working on for the next Demo update:
- Volume and brightness adjustments
- Save functionality (for final product)
- Overall game optimization  

Feel free to let us know if you find any issues or what you think! Your feedback is important!!!

______________________

As we continue to push forward to the completion of the game, we'll continue posting announcements and updates to keep you all in the loop of development. 

We appreciate you all so much. Thank you!

Team Gloomdreary

notes.title: Prophecy Demo 2.5 Patch Now Live!!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Happy Next Fest! Hope you're all enjoying the event so far!

Patch 2.5 is now live with the current fixes:

- Player can no longer right click collectable objects
- Box collisions have been adjusted
- Square Object texture has been changed
- Valve puzzle blueprint has been cleaned up a bit
- Dates on the corkboard have been set to the appropriate years
- Bell puzzle hint in garden moved closer to the puzzle

Thank you all again for your feedback and input! We hope you all continue to enjoy Prophecy and please continue to let us know what you think!!




Team Gloomdreary

notes.title: Demo v.2 Update!!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!!

Demo v.2.0 is now live on Steam!

Thanks to all of the AWESOME feedback we received from all of you who played the demo, we caught of glimpse of what needed fixing and how you all felt about certain things you all would have liked changed/added!!!

So we listened and changed a few things for Demo v2.0:

- Added a basic inventory so players can see what items they currently are holding.
- Adjusted the flashlight to be a bit brighter and wider.
- Adjusted the beginning movement speed a little bit so it's not so slow to start.
- Adjusted some audio volumes of certain things that were "too loud".
- Controls explanation page in the menu options.

Unfortunately we are not able to add in the Audio Volume adjustments in the options menu yet, it's currently something that we are working on along with mouse sensitivity, save data and controller support. :)

We'll be continuing on working on those functionalities while pushing further into polishing the rest of the game!!

We appreciate all of your guys' feedback, support and love! It is you, the players that will help make this game the best it can be. Thank you all so much!

Enjoy the new changes and let us know what you think! 

Ludum

notes.title: Demo v1.2 patch is live!
notes.content:
Demo v.1.2 is live!

A few more small fixes and changes:

- The Blueprint for the basement puzzle has been cleaned up a bit, so it's easier to read. Hopefully this helps players some when it comes to solving it. 
- The "square object" had potential to create a situation where the player couldn't progress.
- Unnecessary story pick up in the basement was removed.
- The player cannot spam the bell which reset the animation per click.

Thank you guys for all of the amazing feedback!

Ludum

notes.title: First patch incoming soon! (Demo v1.1)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thank you all so much for trying out the demo and reaching out to the devs on seen issues for our 
demo release. We're working on the issues brought to our attention so far and will get the patch out as soon as we can! 

This upcoming patch (Demo v1.1) SHOULD fix the following issues:

- Missing assets when set to low scalability
- Mothman seen floating outside of house window after appearing
- Basement puzzle not completing
- Missing collision allowing the player to go out of level bounds

We'll be getting this patch out asap!

If you have any other bugs or issues, please feel free to post them in our community hub! We appreciate you all and hope you're enjoying the demo!

Thank you!
Ludum
